name: get-pr-comments
description: Fetch review and discussion comments on the current branch's pull request, classify human-reviewer feedback against tracked patterns, and turn it into a concise action list. TRIGGER when: user asks to get/fetch/summarize PR comments, "what did reviewers say", "any feedback on my PR", check review comments, or address PR feedback. DO NOT TRIGGER when: user wants a fresh review of a colleague's PR (use review-pr) or of their own local changes (use review-local).
